label: Verification
title: Verification
description: Configure verification gates, understand setup defaults, and collect evidence that your application meets its spec.
code:
[commands]
typecheck = "bun tsc --noEmit"
test = "bun test"

[verify]
steps = ["types", "unit", "app"]

[verify.types]
kind = "check"
command = "typecheck"
always = true

[verify.unit]
kind = "check"
command = "test"

[verify.app]
kind = "agent"
skill = "verify-app"
paths = ["web/**", "src/routes/**"]

[verify]
steps = ["app"]

[verify.app]
kind = "agent"
skill = "verify-app"

[roles.default]
runtime = "codex"
model = "gpt-6.1-sol"

[roles.app]
runtime = "codex"
model = "gpt-6.1-sol"

label: Operating
title: Operating Autobuild
description: Watch durable progress, answer escalations, pause work, and authorize landing through the CLI or an external operator agent.
code: bun ab answer my-build "Keep the public API compatible"

bun ab pause my-build
bun ab resume my-build

bun ab land my-build
bun ab hold my-build
